location_sources.name: dominos_locations_json_demo
location_sources.notes: JSON source-format demo: one published JSON document holding the full US store list. Records sit in a bare top-level array, so record_path is empty.

location_sources.name: little_caesars_locations_get_api_demo
location_sources.display_name: Little Caesars - GET JSON API demo
location_sources.notes: GET JSON API source-format demo: a live public endpoint queried with URL parameters and request headers rather than a file. limit=50 is the endpoint's own per-request ceiling - it accepts a higher value and still answers with 50 rows - and the loader clamps it so the config cannot claim more than the call returns.

demographics_source.name: bigquery_public_zip_geo_acs
demographics_source.query: SELECT z.zip_code, z.city, z.county, z.state_code, z.state_name, z.internal_point_lat AS latitude, z.internal_point_lon AS longitude, a.total_pop AS population, a.households, a.median_income AS median_household_income, a.income_per_capita, a.median_age, a.poverty, a.employed_pop AS employed_population, a.unemployed_pop AS unemployed_population, a.housing_units FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.zip_codes_2018_5yr` a ON z.zip_code = a.geo_id WHERE z.zip_code IS NOT NULL

limitations: ZIP-level matching uses postal code from the location source; address geocoding is outside this prototype.
Similarity is based on configurable z-score distance over the selected ZIP metrics.
The Little Caesars GET JSON API demo is capped at 50 rows per request by the endpoint itself, so it demonstrates the API source format rather than full national coverage.
